fields.q: 我常常在想，向神明祈祷到底有没有意义。
fields.en: I often wonder if there's any point in praying to the gods.
fields.name: 蕾达

q.value: 我常常在想，向神明祈祷到底有没有意义。

en.value: I often wonder if there's any point in praying to the gods.

fields.q: 最近一直睡不好。听听摇篮曲会不会有用呢？
fields.en: I've been having trouble sleeping. I wonder if hearing a lullaby would help.
fields.name: 蕾达

q.value: 最近一直睡不好。听听摇篮曲会不会有用呢？

en.value: I've been having trouble sleeping. I wonder if hearing a lullaby would help.

fields.q: 弹着弹着，常常就弹回了家乡的曲子。大概是想家了吧。
fields.en: In the middle of playing, I often find I'm returning to songs from back home. I guess I'm nostalgic.
fields.name: 蕾达

q.value: 弹着弹着，常常就弹回了家乡的曲子。大概是想家了吧。

en.value: In the middle of playing, I often find I'm returning to songs from back home. I guess I'm nostalgic.

fields.q: 为了达成目的，我愿意不择手段、付出任何牺牲。这样不对吗？
fields.en: I'm willing to use any means, make any sacrifice, to achieve my goal. Is that wrong?
fields.name: 蕾达

q.value: 为了达成目的，我愿意不择手段、付出任何牺牲。这样不对吗？

en.value: I'm willing to use any means, make any sacrifice, to achieve my goal. Is that wrong?

fields.q: 我最受不了蛇。要是这里有蛇，你会帮我赶走吧？
fields.en: I can't stand snakes. If there was a snake here, you would chase it away, right?
fields.name: 蕾达

q.value: 我最受不了蛇。要是这里有蛇，你会帮我赶走吧？

en.value: I can't stand snakes. If there was a snake here, you would chase it away, right?

fields.q: 鸟很会唱歌对吧？那我弹比维拉琴，你来唱怎么样？
fields.en: Birds are good at singing, aren't they? So how about I play my vihuela and you sing for me?
fields.name: 蕾达

q.value: 鸟很会唱歌对吧？那我弹比维拉琴，你来唱怎么样？

en.value: Birds are good at singing, aren't they? So how about I play my vihuela and you sing for me?

fields.q: 要是看见我骑马出去，可要飞下来跟我打招呼哦。
fields.en: If you see me on a horse ride, you'd better swoop down and say hello.
fields.name: 蕾达

q.value: 要是看见我骑马出去，可要飞下来跟我打招呼哦。

en.value: If you see me on a horse ride, you'd better swoop down and say hello.

fields.q: 被掌声包围的感觉真好。想体验的话，我表演时就飞到我身边来吧。
fields.en: It's nice being showered in applause. If you want to experience it, come fly to me when I'm performing.
fields.name: 蕾达

q.value: 被掌声包围的感觉真好。想体验的话，我表演时就飞到我身边来吧。

en.value: It's nice being showered in applause. If you want to experience it, come fly to me when I'm performing.

fields.q: 下次我做饭你要不要尝尝？人类好像都不爱吃我做的菜，不过鸟的话说不定……
fields.en: The next time I make food, will you try it? Humans don't seem to like my cooking, but maybe a bird…
fields.name: 蕾达

q.value: 下次我做饭你要不要尝尝？人类好像都不爱吃我做的菜，不过鸟的话说不定……

en.value: The next time I make food, will you try it? Humans don't seem to like my cooking, but maybe a bird…

fields.q: 跳舞的关键是姿势。驼着背，只会跳出可怜兮兮的舞。
fields.en: The key to dancing is posture. Slouch, and you'll only give a pitiful performance.
fields.name: 蕾达

q.value: 跳舞的关键是姿势。驼着背，只会跳出可怜兮兮的舞。

en.value: The key to dancing is posture. Slouch, and you'll only give a pitiful performance.
